en.html:
Air Defense Soldier A《—The Galley Keep! The fortress in the sky!!》
Air Defense Soldier B《S-so THIS is the world's biggest airship...》
Air Defense Commander《GHQ, bloody bastards. They mean it. They've actually come to finish Rokuhara.》
Air Defense Soldier B《What do we do, Captain sir?!》
Air Defense Commander《Only that one enemy craft?》
Air Defense Soldier A《Yes, sir. One ship only. No other readings nearby.》
Air Defense Soldier A《...Though inside that stomach, sir, I can't imagine there isn't a whole crowd of dragoons.》
Air Defense Commander《Fight it head-on? Madness. But letting that thing near Fudaraku Castle, that also we cannot do.》
Air Defense Commander《Hit, pull back, hit again. Keep stopping its advance. Until reinforcements come, somehow or other you HOLD!》
Air Defense Soldier B《Understood!》

ja.text:
防空隊Ａ《――〝空の要塞ガレーキープ〟!!》防空隊Ｂ《こ、これが世界最大の飛行艦か……》防空隊長《ＧＨＱめ。本気だな。
　本気で六波羅を潰しに来やがった》防空隊Ｂ《どうしますか、隊長!?》防空隊長《敵騎はあれだけか？》防空隊Ａ《はッ、一隻のみです。
　付近に他の反応はありません》防空隊Ａ《……もっとも、あいつの腹に竜騎兵の群れ
が詰まっていないとは思えませんが》防空隊長《まともに戦うのは無謀だな。
　しかし、あんなものを普陀楽城に近づける
わけにはいかん》防空隊長《一撃離脱の繰り返しで足を止めるぞ。
　増援が来るまで何としても粘れ！》防空隊Ｂ《了解！》
